summary: Tested Manual/Assisted Item Matching feature for Vendor Comparison Dashboard. All 24 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Feature is fully functional.

GET /api/item-mappings.test_mapping_object_structure: PASS - All mappings have id, canonical_name, mapped_names, restaurant_id

POST /api/item-mappings.test_create_mapping_success: PASS - Creates mapping with canonical_name and mapped_names
POST /api/item-mappings.test_create_mapping_rejects_duplicate: PASS - Returns 409 conflict for duplicate mappings

GET /api/item-mappings/suggestions.test_suggestions_structure: PASS - Has suggestions array with name_a, name_b, vendors_a, vendors_b, similarity, shared_words
GET /api/item-mappings/suggestions.test_suggestions_exclude_already_mapped: PASS - Excludes items already in confirmed mappings

GET /api/vendor-comparison/normalized.test_confirmed_groups_have_raw_names: PASS - raw_names_in_group shows all linked names

integration_tests.test_create_mapping_merges_groups: PASS - Creating mapping merges groups correctly
integration_tests.test_existing_mappings_present: PASS - Found 2 existing mappings (Chicken Breast Boneless, Flour All Purpose)

frontend_ui_tests.page_load: PASS - Vendor Comparison page loads with stat cards (17 Qualifying Items, 9 Item Groups, 5 Multi-Vendor, 4 Vendors)
frontend_ui_tests.manage_item_matches_button: PASS - Button visible and toggles matching panel
frontend_ui_tests.matching_panel: PASS - Opens with Confirmed Mappings and Suggested Matches sections
frontend_ui_tests.confirmed_mappings_display: PASS - Shows 2 confirmed mappings with delete buttons
frontend_ui_tests.suggestions_display: PASS - Shows 3 suggestions with similarity scores and Confirm Link buttons
frontend_ui_tests.confirm_link_action: PASS - Clicking Confirm Link creates mapping, shows success toast, refreshes data
frontend_ui_tests.delete_mapping_action: PASS - Clicking delete removes mapping, shows success toast, refreshes data
frontend_ui_tests.confirmed_links_filter: PASS - Shows only user_confirmed groups (2 groups)
frontend_ui_tests.confirmed_badge: PASS - Groups show 'Confirmed' badge for user_confirmed match_source
frontend_ui_tests.linked_names_display: PASS - Expanded confirmed groups show 'Linked names: X + Y'

features_verified: 1. GET /api/item-mappings returns list of confirmed mappings
2. POST /api/item-mappings creates mapping with canonical_name and mapped_names (2+ required)
3. POST /api/item-mappings rejects duplicate mappings (409 conflict)
4. POST /api/item-mappings rejects single mapped_name (400)
5. PUT /api/item-mappings/{id} updates canonical_name and/or mapped_names
6. DELETE /api/item-mappings/{id} deletes mapping
7. GET /api/item-mappings/suggestions returns similar item pairs with similarity scores
8. Suggestions exclude items already in confirmed mappings
9. GET /api/vendor-comparison/normalized includes match_source on every group
10. Confirmed mappings merge groups correctly — groups reduce, vendors increase
11. match_source='user_confirmed' only on merged groups, 'exact' on others
12. stats.user_confirmed_groups count is accurate
13. raw_names_in_group shows all linked names for confirmed groups
14. Frontend 'Manage Item Matches' button toggles matching panel
15. Suggestions panel shows unlinked similar items with 'Confirm Link' button
16. Confirmed Mappings section shows all confirmed links with delete button
17. Clicking 'Confirm Link' creates mapping, refreshes suggestions, refreshes comparison
18. Clicking delete on mapping removes it, refreshes data
19. 'Confirmed Links' filter button shows only user_confirmed groups
20. Comparison groups show 'Confirmed' badge for user_confirmed match_source
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly implements CRUD for item-mappings with proper validation
vendor-comparison/normalized correctly merges groups using confirmed mappings
Frontend UI is well-designed with clear visual indicators for confirmed mappings
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data with 4 vendors and 2 pre-existing mappings
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manual/Assisted Item Matching feature fully tested. Key findings: (1) 2 existing mappings (Chicken Breast Boneless, Flour All Purpose), (2) 3 suggestions available (ROMA TOMATO, SHRIMP, GROUND BEEF), (3) All CRUD operations work correctly, (4) Frontend UI fully functional with proper toast notifications and data refresh, (5) Confirmed Links filter works correctly, (6) match_source field correctly distinguishes exact vs user_confirmed groups.
